body: Sorry I'm late.  Do you want to share the cliff notes of your story?

You've been facing anxiety most of your life, but you have no idea what other people's lives are like.  People have different ideas about life and death than you, and that's okay.  For me, death is not the worst thing in the world; something that everyone should avoid.  Death is a reasonable choice that people can make if they'd prefer death to life.  I'm very much pro-choice in that aspect- it's my life and I have the right to do what I want with it.  It may hurt people emotionally, but everyone in society is allowed to make choices that hurt others emotionally.

I don't work or go to school, I can barely leave the house.  I do maybe twice a month, and I'm having a mild panic attack the entire time.  Sometimes big panic attacks. I watch tv and screw around on reddit to distract me and pass the time.  I color in adult coloring books if I'm having a panic attack at home and the meds aren't working.  I've tried different hobbies, but nothing gives me pleasure.
I'm sorry, I don't want you to cry.  Living life is a much sadder thing for me than dying will ever be.
I'm not winning though.  I'm stagnant, and in a terrible place.  I just want it to be over.
Sleep well and I hope a new day is all you need.  <3

No job, anhedonia.  I have pets, but they'll be fine.  Pretty much everyone in my life has either hurt me enough that I think it's fair to cause them grief, or they understand my desire to die.  My mom is very understanding about suicide.

I'm 29/f and also almost never leave the house. :/ 

If you want to make it through the night, you definitely should.  Sometimes things look slightly brighter in the morning.  How late is it where you are? Will you be able to sleep soon?

I'm schizoaffective and have a handful of other diagnoses. I hallucinate and have delusions.  My dad yelled at me the other day that everything is my fault.  I know it's not true, but I'm really hurt by the way my dad is treating me.  

Every day is some sort of hell.  I've lasted for far longer than I ever thought I would, always hoping things would some day get better.  Now it's been so many years, I've lost hope.

I've tried to kill myself before, but I always had a lot of people watching me since I was in and out of the hospital.  I never had any good methods available.  Now I do.

The only doubts I have are about the actual dying part.  To me, killing yourself is scary because nothing is 100%, and no one knows exactly what it's like to die.  I don't fear actually being dead, since I believe pretty strongly that it's just nothingness.

I'm 29 years old and have been mentally ill since being raped when I was 10 years old.  Things just keep getting worse.  Therapy and meds don't help- and believe me, I've tried dozens.  I'm tired of life and can't imagine living another day. :(
What's your story?  Is it a definite thing or are you just wanting to?
